Personal Information

  • Address (if required)

  • Appointment details

You only share this information with us when you choose to — for example, by filling out a form, calling us, or sending a message.

Medical & Dental Information

This information is kept strictly confidential.

Website Usage Information

When you visit our website, we may automatically collect basic technical information such as:

  • Your IP address
  • Browser type
  • Pages visited
  • Time spent on the website

This helps us improve our website and provide a better user experience.

  1.  How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Schedule and manage appointments
  • Provide dental treatments and care
  • Send appointment reminders
  • Respond to your queries
  • Improve our services and website
  • Meet legal or regulatory requirements

We do not sell your personal information to anyone.

  1.  How We Protect Your Information

We take appropriate steps to protect your personal and medical information. Your data is stored securely and accessed only by authorized staff.

While we do our best to keep your information safe, no online system can be 100% secure. However, we continuously work to maintain strong security measures.

  1.  Sharing Your Information

We only share your information when:

  • It is necessary to provide treatment
  • You have given us permission

We do not share your data for advertising or marketing by third parties.

  1. Cookies

Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience. Cookies help us understand how visitors use our site.

You can disable cookies in your browser settings if you prefer.

  1. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Ask what personal information we have about you
  • Request corrections if something is incorrect
  • Ask for your information to be deleted (where legally allowed)

To make such a request, please contact us.

  1.  Children’s Privacy

If a child receives treatment at our clinic, we collect information only with the consent of a parent or legal guardian.

  1.  Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.

Dental Implants Treatment

Welcome to Hyderabad Smiles, your premier destination for advanced dental implant solutions in Hyderabad. If you’re missing one or more teeth, dental implants offer a long-lasting, natural-looking, and functional replacement that can transform your smile and improve your quality of life.

Dental implants offer a great solution for those with missing or damaged teeth. The tooth implant treatment not only brings back the look and function of your natural smile but also provides a long-lasting result.

Book An Appointment

What are Dental Implants?

Dental implants are artificial tooth roots, typically made of biocompatible titanium, that are surgically placed into your jawbone. They provide a stable foundation for replacement teeth, such as crowns, bridges, or dentures. Implants mimic the function of natural tooth roots, stimulating the jawbone and preventing bone loss that can occur after tooth loss.

Why and When Dental implants are needed?

Dental implants are needed when one or more teeth are missing due to various reasons, and they are chosen because they offer numerous benefits compared to other tooth replacement options like dentures or bridges.

Replacing Missing Teeth

The primary reason is to replace missing teeth, restoring the ability to chew, speak, and smile properly

After Tooth Loss

When a tooth is lost, the jawbone in that area is no longer stimulated and begins to deteriorate (bone resorption). Dental implants act like natural tooth roots, providing the necessary stimulation to preserve the jawbone density and structure.

Denture Stabilisation

A missing tooth can cause the adjacent teeth to shift into the empty space, leading to misalignment, bite problems, and increased risk of decay and gum disease. Implants fill the gap and keep the remaining teeth stable.

Improved Chewing Efficiency

Missing teeth can make it difficult to chew food thoroughly, potentially leading to digestive issues. Implants restore your bite force and allow you to eat a wider variety of foods comfortably.

Improved Appearance

Dental implants are designed to look, feel, and function like natural teeth, providing a seamless and confident smile.

Types of Dental implants

At Hyderabad Smiles, we understand that each patient’s needs are unique. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range of dental implant options to ensure we can provide the most suitable solution for your individual situation. Our experienced implant specialists will conduct a thorough assessment to determine the best type of implant for you. Here are some of the common types of dental implants we offer:

Endosteal Implants:

Surgically placed directly into the jawbone, these screw, cylinder, or blade-shaped implants provide a stable foundation for individual or multiple tooth replacements. They are the most common and versatile type of implant.

Subperiosteal Implants:

Positioned on top of the jawbone under the gums, this metal frame with posts offers an alternative for those with insufficient bone height who prefer to avoid bone grafting. It provides support for replacement teeth.

All-on-4 Implants:

This efficient technique uses only four strategically placed implants to support a full arch of replacement teeth (upper or lower). It's a cost-effective way to restore complete chewing function and aesthetics.

Immediate Load Basal Implants:

Offering a faster solution, these implants are placed and can often receive temporary crowns on the same day. They anchor into denser basal bone, potentially benefiting those seeking immediate results.

Single-Stage Implants:

Placed with a healing abutment already attached and visible above the gums, this eliminates the need for a second surgery to expose the implant. It can shorten the overall treatment timeline for suitable candidates.

When Dental Implants Are Needed:

Dental implants are considered a suitable option in various situations:

  • Single Missing Tooth: To replace a single tooth without affecting the adjacent healthy teeth.
  • Multiple Missing Teeth: To support implant-supported bridges, replacing several missing teeth in a row.
  • All Missing Teeth (Full Edentulism): As a foundation for full arch implant-supported dentures (overdentures) or fixed full arch bridges (like All-on-4 or All-on-6).
  • Loose or Unstable Dentures: To provide better stability and retention for removable dentures, improving comfort and function.
  • Failed Root Canal or Severely Damaged Tooth: When a tooth cannot be saved by other means and needs to be extracted.
  • Congenitally Missing Teeth: In cases where one or more teeth never developed.
  • Trauma or Injury: Following tooth loss due to an accident or injury.
    When a Bridge Needs Replacement: Implants can be a more long-term and stable alternative to replacing an old or failing dental bridge.

The Dental Implant Procedure at Hyderabad Smiles

  • Consultation and Evaluation: Your journey begins with a comprehensive examination, including a review of your medical and dental history, a thorough oral exam, and necessary diagnostic imaging (X-rays, CT scans). We will discuss your treatment options, answer your questions, and develop a personalized plan.
  • Implant Placement: The implant is surgically placed into your jawbone under local anesthesia, and sedation if needed. The gum tissue is closed over the implant, which is left to heal and integrate with the bone (osseointegration) for several weeks or months.
  • Abutment Placement: Once osseointegration is complete, a small connector post called an abutment is attached to the implant. This serves as the attachment point for the replacement tooth.
  • Crown/Prosthesis Placement: A custom-made crown (for a single tooth), bridge (for multiple teeth), or denture is fabricated and attached to the abutment, completing your new smile.

Cost of Dental Implants in Hyderabad

The cost of dental implants can vary depending on several factors, including the number of implants needed, the type of implant, the complexity of the case, and any additional procedures required (such as bone grafting or sinus lift).

  • Single Tooth Implant: The cost for a single dental implant in Hyderabad can range from ₹20,000 to ₹50,000 or more, including the implant, abutment, and crown.
  • Full Mouth Implants: The cost for full mouth rehabilitation with dental implants can range from ₹3,00,000 to ₹7,00,000 or more per arch, depending on the number of implants and the type of prosthetic teeth used (e.g., fixed bridge or implant-supported denture).
  • All-on-4 Implants: The cost for an All-on-4 procedure in Hyderabad can range from ₹1,50,000 to ₹2,50,000 or more per jaw.

Braces are comparatively painful than aligners.

Depends on the severity of case. Simple cases are done faster with aligners.

Braces – No hard and sticky foods. Aligners – No food restrictions.

Anyone can get aligners, children and adults, no age restrictions.

Yes, they are necessary to prevent relapse (tooth going back to their original positions as before the treatment).

Orthodontics

We provide expert orthodontic solutions to align your teeth and perfect your smile. Using advanced braces and clear aligners, we ensure a comfortable, effective, and personalized treatment plan. Trust Hyderabad Smiles for a straighter, healthier, and more confident smile.

Orthodontics focuses on correcting misaligned teeth and jaw irregularities to improve both function and aesthetics. Whether you need braces, clear aligners, or other advanced treatments, our expert orthodontists ensure a straighter, healthier, and more confident smile.

Our Approach

At Hyderabad Smiles, we combine precision with advanced orthodontic techniques to provide tailored treatments that enhance both aesthetics and oral health. Our team ensures a smooth, comfortable, and seamless orthodontic experience.

Metal Braces

If you have severely misaligned, overcrowded, or crooked teeth, our Metal Braces treatment at Hyderabad Smiles Dental Clinic offers a highly effective solution. Using durable stainless-steel brackets and wires, metal braces gradually shift your teeth into perfect alignment. This time-tested orthodontic treatment provides precise and reliable results, ensuring a straighter and healthier smile. With expert orthodontic care and advanced techniques, we make the process comfortable and efficient for long-lasting transformation.

Ceramic Braces

For those seeking a more discreet orthodontic solution, Ceramic Braces at Hyderabad Smiles Dental Clinic provide an aesthetic alternative to traditional metal braces. These tooth-colored or clear braces blend seamlessly with your natural teeth while offering the same effectiveness in straightening misaligned teeth. Whether you have gaps, crowding, or bite issues, ceramic braces help you achieve a confident smile with a less noticeable appearance, ensuring both comfort and precision throughout your treatment.

Lingual Braces

If you want a completely invisible way to straighten your teeth, our Lingual Braces treatment at Hyderabad Smiles Dental Clinic is the perfect choice. Placed behind the teeth, these custom-made braces correct misalignments without being visible. Ideal for professionals, public speakers, or anyone concerned about aesthetics, lingual braces provide a discreet yet powerful orthodontic solution. With advanced technology and personalized care, we ensure a seamless and effective journey to a perfectly aligned smile.

Self-Ligating Braces

Experience a faster and more comfortable orthodontic journey with Self-Ligating Braces at Hyderabad Smiles Dental Clinic. Designed with a built-in sliding mechanism, these braces reduce friction and pressure on your teeth, allowing for smoother movement and shorter treatment times. Whether you need to fix overcrowding, gaps, or bite issues, self-ligating braces offer a modern and efficient way to achieve a beautifully aligned smile with fewer adjustments and enhanced comfort.

Using advanced techniques such as metal braces, ceramic braces, lingual braces, and self-ligating braces, we ensure effective and comfortable treatment tailored to your needs. Our goal is to enhance both the function and appearance of your teeth, giving you a confident smile that lasts a lifetime.

About Aligners Treatment in Hyderabad

Aligners are transparent, removable trays designed to gradually shift your teeth into the desired position. Unlike traditional braces, aligners are virtually invisible, offering a comfortable and aesthetic solution for correcting misalignment, gaps, or bite issues. At Hyderabad Smiles, clear aligners offer a discreet and comfortable path to your ideal smile. These virtually invisible aligners gently and progressively guide your teeth into their desired positions. For optimal results, the aligners should be worn consistently for 20-22 hours daily. You’ll appreciate the minimally invasive nature of this treatment, as there are no wires or brackets to cause irritation. Plus, you can smile confidently knowing that these aligners won’t stain or discolor.

Types of Aligners Treatment Provided by Us

At Hyderabad Smiles, we use the latest 3D scanning and digital planning to design aligners tailored to your unique dental structure. Our expert orthodontists ensure precise treatment to give you the smile you’ve always wanted—without the discomfort of metal braces.

Clear Aligners (Invisible Braces)

Clear aligners offer a virtually invisible orthodontic solution, making them ideal for those who prefer a discreet way to straighten their teeth. These custom-made trays gently shift teeth into place over time, providing a comfortable and effective alternative to traditional braces. Unlike metal braces, clear aligners are removable, allowing for easy eating and maintaining proper oral hygiene.

Hybrid Aligners

Hybrid aligners combine the benefits of clear aligners and traditional braces, making them ideal for more complex cases. They are used when certain teeth require extra guidance for precise alignment. This approach provides the advantages of both invisibility and effective correction, offering a discreet yet powerful treatment option.

Teen aligners

Teen aligners are specifically designed for teenagers, allowing room for growing teeth while effectively aligning the smile. These aligners come with wear indicators to ensure proper usage and compliance. They offer a more comfortable and confidence-boosting alternative to traditional braces, making orthodontic treatment easier and less noticeable for teens.

Advantages of Clear Teeth Aligners

Clear aligners have become a preferred orthodontic solution, offering numerous advantages over traditional braces. These transparent and removable aligners gently guide your teeth to correct alignment and bite issues, providing you with a host of benefits:

Enhanced Oral Hygiene

Unlike fixed braces, these aligners are easily removable. This allows you to maintain your regular brushing and flossing routine without any obstructions, significantly reducing the risk of cavities and gum disease.

Reduced Risk of Tooth Decay

Clear aligners eliminate the need for brackets and wires that can trap food particles and make cleaning your teeth challenging. With clear aligners, you can keep your teeth clean more effectively, reducing the risk of cavities and tooth decay.

Unrestricted Diet

Enjoy all your favorite foods! Because clear aligners are removable, you don't have to worry about food restrictions that typically come with traditional braces.

Natural Speech

Our invisible aligners have minimal impact on your speech, allowing for clearer and more natural communication during your treatment journey.

Our Approach & Procedure

At Hyderabad Smiles, your clear aligner journey involves these key steps:

  • Detailed Assessment and Personalized Planning: Our orthodontist meticulously evaluates the alignment of your teeth. Using this comprehensive assessment and understanding your unique smile goals, we create a tailored treatment plan just for you.
  • Precise Digital Modeling: We utilize advanced digital impressions to generate an accurate 3D model of your teeth. This detailed model is crucial for mapping out the precise movements needed to achieve your ideal smile.
  • Custom Aligner Fabrication: Based on the final digital model, a series of clear aligners is custom-manufactured. Each aligner in the sequence is designed to apply gentle and specific forces, guiding your teeth through incremental adjustments.
  • Consistent Wear: You will wear each set of aligners for approximately two weeks, for at least 22 hours per day. This consistent wear allows for the gradual and controlled movement of your teeth.
  • Step-by-Step Progression: As you complete each two-week period, you will move on to the next set of aligners in your personalized sequence. Each subsequent aligner builds upon the progress of the previous one, gradually shifting your teeth towards their optimal alignment.

Generally, our patients in Hyderabad can expect the investment in clear aligners to range from approximately ₹50,000 to ₹1,50,000 (For mild cases).

Advanced Periodontics & Gum Care Treatments

Periodontics focuses on the health of your gums and supporting structures of your teeth. It involves preventing, diagnosing, and treating gum disease, as well as procedures to restore gum health and maintain a strong foundation for your teeth. Healthy gums are essential for a beautiful, long-lasting smile!

Our Periodontist Treatments Include:

At Hyderabad Smiles, we use the latest diagnostic tools and minimally invasive treatments to ensure optimal gum health. Our experienced periodontists provide personalized care to help prevent and treat gum disease, restoring the health and beauty of your smile.

Scaling & Root Planing (Deep Cleaning)

Scaling and root planing is a non-surgical treatment designed to remove plaque and tartar buildup beneath the gumline. This procedure helps prevent the progression of gum disease while promoting healing. It also reduces gum inflammation and improves overall gum health, leading to a healthier smile.

Gum Grafting

Gum grafting is a procedure that treats gum recession by restoring lost gum tissue. It helps protect tooth roots from exposure and prevents further damage. Additionally, gum grafting enhances the appearance of your gums, promoting a healthier and more aesthetically pleasing smile.

Periodontal Surgery

For more advanced cases of gum disease, surgical interventions may be necessary. Our periodontists perform various procedures to eliminate deep pockets, regenerate lost bone and gum tissue, and address complex periodontal defects, ensuring the stability and longevity of your teeth.

Dental Implants

As specialists in the supporting structures of teeth, our periodontists are highly skilled in the precise placement of dental implants. We ensure your gums and jawbone are in optimal health to provide a strong and stable foundation for your implants, crucial for their success and long-term integration.

When Periodontist Treatment Are Needed:

Periodontist treatment is crucial for maintaining the health and stability of your gums and the supporting bone around your teeth. You should consider seeing a periodontist at Hyderabad Smiles if you notice any of the following signs or conditions:

  • Bleeding, Swollen, or Tender Gums: Gums that bleed easily when brushing or flossing, or appear red, puffy, and sore, are classic signs of gingivitis (early gum disease) or periodontitis.
  • Persistent Bad Breath: Chronic bad breath or a foul taste in your mouth, even with good oral hygiene, can indicate a bacterial infection beneath the gum line.
  • Gum Recession or “Longer” Looking Teeth: If your gums are pulling away from your teeth, making your teeth appear longer, it’s a sign of gum recession and potential underlying bone loss.
  • Loose or Shifting Teeth: As gum disease progresses, the bone and tissues supporting your teeth can be destroyed, leading to teeth becoming loose, shifting position, or even falling out.
  • Painful Chewing or Changes in Bite: Discomfort while chewing, or a noticeable change in how your upper and lower teeth fit together, can be indicators of advanced gum disease affecting your tooth support.
  • Deep Pockets Between Teeth and Gums: Your dentist or hygienist may inform you if you have deep pockets (greater than 3mm) around your teeth, as these are areas where bacteria thrive and are difficult to clean effectively.
  • Presence of Pus: Any pus oozing from between your teeth and gums is a clear sign of an active infection requiring immediate periodontal attention.
  • Systemic Health Conditions: If you have conditions like diabetes, heart disease, or are a smoker, you are at a higher risk for gum disease, and regular periodontal evaluations are highly recommended.

The Periodontist Treatment Procedure at Hyderabad Smiles

  • Comprehensive Diagnosis: We start with a thorough exam, including X-rays and pocket depth measurements, to precisely diagnose your gum condition and create a personalized treatment plan.
  • Non-Surgical Care (Deep Cleaning): For initial stages, we perform meticulous scaling and root planing (deep cleaning) to remove plaque and tartar and smooth root surfaces, promoting gum healing.
  • Surgical Intervention (When Needed): For advanced cases, our periodontists perform specialized surgeries like flap surgery, bone grafting, or gum grafting to address deep pockets and regenerate lost tissues.
  • Ongoing Maintenance & Follow-up: Post-treatment, we provide essential care instructions and schedule regular supportive therapy appointments to ensure long-term gum health and prevent recurrence.

Severe Tooth Decay

When decay has reached too deep down into a tooth's pulp, it becomes necessary to remove the infected or inflamed pulp and prevent further damage.

Advanced Dental Implants with Painless & Affordable Care

We offer permanent, natural-looking dental implants to restore missing teeth. With advanced technology and precise placement, our implants provide comfort, durability, and a seamless smile. Trust Hyderabad Smiles for a lasting solution to enhance your smile and oral health.

Oral and maxillofacial are a permanent and reliable solution for replacing missing teeth. They consist of a titanium post that integrates with the jawbone, providing a stable base for crowns, bridges, or dentures. Dental implants offer a durable, natural-looking alternative to traditional dentures or bridges, restoring both the functionality and aesthetics of your smile.

Why chose Dental implants?

  • Natural Appearance: Implants look and feel just like your natural teeth.
  • Durability: With proper care, implants can last a lifetime.
  • Improved Function: Enjoy easy chewing, speaking, and smiling without discomfort.
  • Preserved Jawbone: Implants stimulate the jawbone, preventing bone loss.

Our Approach

At Hyderabad Smiles, we prioritize comfort, precision, and patient care. Our skilled team will guide you through the entire process—from the initial consultation to post-treatment care—ensuring your dental implants blend seamlessly with your natural smile.

BOI Implants

BOI (Basal Osseo integrated) Implants, a revolutionary solution for patients with significant bone loss or those who have been told they are not candidates for traditional implants. BOI implants are designed to be placed in the basal bone, bypassing the need for bone grafting, making them ideal for patients who want a faster, less invasive treatment.

Pterygoid Implants

Pterygoid Implants, a specialized solution for patients with severe bone loss in the upper jaw. These implants are placed in the pterygoid region of the skull, offering a stable foundation for dental restorations without the need for complex bone grafting or sinus lifts.

Zygomatic Implants

Zygomatic Implants, an advanced solution for patients with severe bone loss in the upper jaw. Unlike traditional implants that require a healthy amount of bone for support, Zygomatic Implants are anchored into the zygomatic bone (cheekbone), providing a stable foundation for dental restorations when the upper jaw lacks sufficient bone.

All-on-4 Implants

All-on-4 Implants, a groundbreaking solution for patients who need a full set of upper or lower teeth but have insufficient bone for traditional implants. This innovative procedure uses just four strategically placed implants to support an entire arch of teeth, offering a permanent and cost-effective solution to restore your smile.

Dental Services We Offer

Dental Implants

A dental implant is a small titanium post that is gently placed  to replace the root of a missing tooth. Once in place, it acts as a strong foundation for a crown, bridge, or denture, giving you a lasting and natural-looking solution to restore your smile.

Clear Aligners

Clear aligners are a series of custom-made, transparent trays designed to gradually move teeth into the desired position. They are removable and virtually invisible during wear, providing a discreet alternative to traditional braces.

Root Canal Treatment

 A root canal procedure is performed to treat an infected or severely decayed tooth. It involves the removal of the damaged pulp within the tooth, followed by filling and sealing the space to restore the tooth’s function and prevent further infection.

Scaling and Gum Curettage

This deep cleaning procedure involves the removal of plaque and tartar from both above and below the gumline. It is a therapeutic treatment used to manage periodontal disease by cleaning the root surfaces and promoting gum health.

Extractions

A tooth extraction is the surgical removal of a tooth that is damaged, decayed, or compromised due to disease. It is often necessary when a tooth cannot be saved through other restorative treatments.

Orthodontic Braces

This treatment involves the use of braces to correct dental misalignment and malocclusions. It helps to align the teeth and improve bite function, enhancing both aesthetics and long-term oral health.

Wisdom Teeth Removal

Wisdom teeth removal is a surgical procedure to extract one or more of the third molars, commonly known as wisdom teeth, which may be impacted, infected, or causing other dental issues. These teeth are often removed when there is insufficient space in the mouth for them to properly emerge or when they are misaligned.

Dental Crown

A dental crown is a custom-made cap that covers a damaged or weakened tooth to restore its shape, size, strength, and appearance. Crowns are typically used after root canal therapy or to protect a tooth with significant decay or wear.

Prosthetic Bridge

A dental bridge is a prosthetic device used to replace one or more missing teeth. It consists of one or more artificial teeth anchored to adjacent natural teeth or implants, providing a functional and aesthetic solution for tooth loss.
